scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @colchon/treasury build && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk build && node scripts/dev.mjs
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @colchon/treasury lint && pnpm --filter @colchon/api lint && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @colchon/treasury build && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk build && pnpm --filter @colchon/api build && pnpm --filter @colchon/api typecheck && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @colchon/treasury build && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk build && pnpm --filter @colchon/api build
scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @colchon/treasury test && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk test && pnpm --filter nessie-node-sdk test:package && pnpm --filter @colchon/api test
scripts.db:lint: supabase db lint --local --schema public,private --level error --fail-on error
scripts.verify: pnpm check:encoding && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
